description: BLAST-TNG is the next-generation Balloon-borne Large Aperture Submillimeter Telescope, with a 2.5 m mirror and three bands at 250, 350 and 500 microns.
short_description: BLAST-TNG next-generation balloon telescope bands, 250-500 μm
facility_description: BLAST-TNG is a stratospheric balloon telescope that follows BLASTPol.
notes: The paper says 250, 350 and 500 microns. NJM's keys are 250min, 350min and 500min. The spelling min was not found on the opened abstract, so no per-band Description was attached and the keys were not renamed. bibcode:2019PhDT........69G was not opened. No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
